subject: ggplot output to device does not work in {} ?

messages.author: d1c330594e46fa88
messages.subject: ggplot output to device does not work in {} ?
parts:
I am experiencing an issue where calling ggplot output to device does
not work if it is called in bracket, such as if() {...} .

For example, the following code will create two files, if-pdf-test.pdf
and none-pdf-test.pdf. However, if-pdf-test.pdf will not contain any
page, although none-pdf-test.pdf looks OK.

I tried this with R versions 2.15.3 and 3.0.1 and both had the same
problem...any suggestion?

library(ggplot2)
outdir <- "c:/"
data1 <- data.frame(a=c(1,2,3), b=c(3,2,5))
if (TRUE) {
Label <- "if-pdf"
pdf(paste(outdir, "/", Label, "-test.pdf", sep=""))
ggplot(data1) + geom_line(aes(a,b))
dev.off()
}

Label <- "none-pdf"
pdf(paste(outdir, "/", Label, "-test.pdf", sep=""))
ggplot(data1) + geom_line(aes(a,b))
dev.off()

--
Thanks,

Yasutaka danke Hirasawa
